entries.description: every dictionary entry in reading order down the left column and then down the right column; exclude running headers and page numbers

headword.description: the Spanish headword exactly as printed

pronunciation.description: the pronunciation text exactly as printed inside parentheses, excluding the parentheses

partOfSpeech.description: all abbreviated part-of-speech markers printed for the headword, in printed order and separated by a semicolon and space when more than one marker appears; exclude English gloss words

englishTranslation.description: all English gloss text belonging to the headword through immediately before the next headword, excluding part-of-speech markers; preserve sense order, separate interleaved part-of-speech gloss groups with a semicolon and space, and include any indented phrase translations
